statement: Bounded terminal successor: the shipped lagrange service install/dev-install/list/status/remove surface uses only authenticated PG-wire lifecycle SQL, pins remote or locally built OCI manifests, requires replayable mutation idempotency, drains typed output, and fails every validation, build, write, transport, authorization, or ambiguous-result error without fallback.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

This Quest is the bounded terminal receipt for service-install-lifecycle-cli after three independently preserved receipts crossed the predecessor's cumulative scope-pressure byte limit. Its source attempt contains exactly the nine production/proof paths from the approved final predecessor receipt, has no new implementation behavior, and leaves the predecessor history intact as evidence rather than bypassing its gate.

The router supports exactly init plus install, dev-install, list, status, and remove with the sealed options. Lifecycle commands use one production pg Client and only INSTALL SERVICE $1, REMOVE SERVICE $1, SHOW SERVICE $1, or SHOW SERVICES with their exact bind cardinalities; no WebSocket, direct owner, alternate socket, catalog, runtime, or retry fallback is reachable.

Install validates bounded ordinary remote manifests. Dev-install pins an immutable ordinary-file project snapshot, calls the single S5b ServiceLocalOciLayoutBuilder, materializes the receipt digest into an atomically published validated manifest without link or project-identity races, and submits that exact local OCI layout payload.

Successful commands emit only deterministic typed server rows plus the dev-install receipt/path after transport and stream completion. Invalid argv/input/name/result, credential rejection, query/disconnect ambiguity, builder failure, local-write failure, project swap, or large piped output truncation is explicitly covered and cannot invent success or leak secrets.

The shipped source and SEA bundle engage password-authenticated PG-wire. Independent exact and aggregate verification must retain three consecutive full scenario passes and prove red when PG routing is removed, receipt digest pinning is omitted, mutation idempotency is omitted, or a WebSocket/direct-owner fallback is introduced.

The only changed paths are src/sea-entry.js, src/cli/service-command-router.js, the three dedicated lifecycle CLI modules, the focused scenario runner, the focused CLI test, the real PG-wire integration test, and the SEA bundle smoke test. Package dependency promotion was already landed by service-cli-pg-runtime-dependency-v2; server owners and S5b internals remain excluded.
